title: AI 2026‑11‑11全景：安全对齐突破、硬件升级、资本巨潮与新场景渗透
core_insight: AI安全对齐的元推理突破与Anthropic创纪录的IPO共同标志着监管压力与资本高度集中交汇，驱动AI快速进入法律、医疗、可穿戴等受监管的新垂直领域。

dimension_texts.technology: META-IR实现自适应安全对齐提升LLM抗jailbreak能力；WorldMind通过测试时尺度的潜在世界模拟显著提升视觉空间推理；AlphaProof Code在Lean中自动生成数百万行证明，开启软件可验证新范式；Retrofitting Unbounded Context让现有LLM支持远超训练窗口的上下文长度。 安全对齐的元推理框架、测试时尺度的世界模拟、Process‑then‑Retrieve视觉语言两阶段框架、混合精度KV‑cache量化的效率优先范式。 META-IR: Meta-Introspective Reasoning for Adaptive Safety Alignment in LLM WorldMind: Test-Time Scaling for Visual Spatial Reasoning through Latent World Simulation Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth Retrofitting Unbounded Context onto Stock Language Models Process then Retrieve: Investigating the Origins of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
dimension_texts.infrastructure: LoRazor通过裁剪Adapter执行路径显著降低多LoRA场景推理成本；Gemini 4 Carbon采用高效模型压缩降低部署费用；混合精度KV‑cache量化在多Agent并发推理中削减最高40%内存带宽和计算。 Google发布两款新TPU专注机密模型训练和大显存，提升算力供给；当日未有其他芯片发布，软件层面的效率提升成为主要驱动力。 LoRazor: Trimming Adapter Execution for Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving Gemini 4 Carbon is now available Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
dimension_texts.application: 法律（OpenAI与Gilbert+Tobin合作）、护理与教育（OpenAI Academy）、初级医疗（Oura收购Counsel Health）、科学发现（PSI使用Anthropic模型）、可穿戴消费（Meta Muse）、临床决策支持（MedToolFault/MedGuard）、精神健康监测、EEG/fNIRS脑机接口、BIM编程、AI辅助专利撰写等新场景。 Business Profiles让ChatGPT取代传统企业目录；Claude Meetings挑战传统会议纪要工具；AI工具开始替代手工专利准备和传统临床规则系统，提升速度但带来可靠性与合规风险。 Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
